SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S REGISTRY No. D 3922 Special Branch S.2. Date 21/8/32）
Date August 11, 1932.

Subject (in full) Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to Cease Hostilities in Shanghai and to Support the Volunteer Armies in the North East, 297 Wei Loh Li (會樂里), Yunnan Road.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by （手写签名）

See file
D 3919

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer i/c Special Branch on the attached report dated August 10 on the subject of confidential letter No.372 from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, dated July 21, 1932, addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Council, relating to the "Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to Cease Hostilities in Shanghai and to Support the Volunteer Armies in the North East" located at No. 297 Wei Loh Li, Yunnan Road, I have to state that the activities of this subversive organization have been communicated to the owner of the premises named Lieu Ching Tuh (劉金德) residing at U 127 Peking Road who has been advised against the renting of his premises to radical elements in future.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期：1932年8月11日。

主题（全称）：上海民众反对淞沪停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会，云南路会乐里297号。
制作人：督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)。转呈人：（手写签名）

参见档案
D 3919

遵照特别处主管官员的指示，就随附的8月10日关于大上海市政府1932年7月21日致上海工部局的第372号密函的报告，该函涉及位于云南路会乐里297号的“上海民众反对淞沪停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会”，本人谨陈述如下：已将该颠覆组织的活动情况告知该处所业主刘金德 (Lieu Ching Tuh)，其住址为北京路 U 127 号，并已劝告其今后勿将房屋出租给激进分子。

Subject (in full) Confidential letter No.372 from the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai dated July 21, 1932 addressed to the Shanghai
Municipal Council.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by DB Km. al.

With reference to the attached confidential letter
No.372 from Mr. Yu Ong Kyuin, Chief Secretary of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, dated July 21, 1932 addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Council on the subject of communist
organizations, I have to report that careful enquiries have
been made with the following result :-

(1) Preparatory Committee for the Shanghai Peoples Society to
Support the North Eastern Volunteer Armies (上海民眾援助
東北義勇軍後援會籌備會)

This Preparatory Committee is incorporated with the
"Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to Cease
Hostilities in Shanghai and to Support the Volunteer Armies in
the North East", with offices at No.297 Wei Loh Li (會樂里),
Yunnan Road. This Federation is known to the Police to
harbour "Red" elements but owing to lack of evidence, no action
has been taken. Following the arrest of 93 of its members and
adherents by the Chinese Authorities on July 17, 1932 when they
were holding a meeting of representatives of Anti-Imperialist
organization in Kiangsu in the Kung Wu Tai Theatre, Robison Road,
the office at No.297 Wei Loh Li has been practically deserted and
the functioning of this organization appears to have reached a
deadlock.

(2) Distressed Young Men's Anti-Japanese Mutual Aid Society
(被難青年反日互濟會), Ming Tan Middle School (鳴旦中學).
Avenue Foch.

The Ming Tan Middle School has been occupying No.18
Kong Loh Tsung, Avenue Foch, for the past four months. During
February 1932 when the school was located at No.357 Avenue
Foch, the Distressed Young Men's Anti-Japanese Mutual Aid Society

主题（全称）：大上海市政府1932年7月21日致上海工部局的第372号密函。
制作人：督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)。转呈人：DB Km. al.

关于随附的大上海市政府秘书长余鸿庆 (Yu Ong Kyuin) 先生于1932年7月21日致上海工部局、主题为共产党组织的第372号密函，本人经仔细查询后报告结果如下：

(1) 上海民众援助东北义勇军后援会筹备会

该筹备会与“上海民众反对淞沪停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会”合并，办公地点位于云南路会乐里297号。警方知悉该联合会窝藏“赤色”分子，但因缺乏证据，未采取行动。继1932年7月17日其中93名成员及追随者在罗宾森路 (Robison Road) 公舞台剧院举行江苏反帝组织代表会议时被中国当局逮捕后，云南路会乐里297号的办事处实际上已无人使用，该组织的运作似乎已陷入僵局。

(2) 被难青年反日互济会，鸣旦中学。
霞飞路 (Avenue Foch)。

鸣旦中学在过去四个月中一直占用霞飞路孔乐总 (Kong Loh Tsung) 18号。1932年2月，当该校位于霞飞路357号时，被难青年反日互济会

removing to an unknown destination or being dissolved. The
school itself is above suspicion because it is run by persons who
are mostly respectable members of the Kuomintang. The
institution is registered with the Educational Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

(3) Shanghai Peoples Anti-Imperialist League (上海人民反帝同盟),
Wei Mong Primary School (卫蒙小学), 1163 Wating Road.

The above address was raided by the Municipal Police
on the authority of a Shanghai Special District Court Warrant
issued at the instance of the Public Safety Bureau on July 22,
1932 but nothing was found to show that this organization occupied
an office in this building.

(4) Japanese Returned Students Association (留日归国学生会),
Dai Loh Fong (大乐坊), Avenue Dubail.

On July 22, the French Police executed a search
warrant issued by the 3rd Branch of the Kiangsu High Court at the
request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau against the above
association. Nothing of an incriminating nature was found and
no arrests made.

(5) Shanghai Women's Anti-Imperialist League (上海妇女反帝同盟)

This organization is better known as the "Chinese
Women's Anti-Japanese and National Salvation League". It was
formerly established at the Kwang Hwa Primary School (光华小学),
No. 1267 Robison Road. This address was raided by the Municipal
Police on March 7, 1932 and eleven persons found on the premises
arrested and a large quantity of communist literature seized.
Five of the accused were later sentenced to terms of imprisonment
ranging from 1½ years to 4 months while the remainder released on

Translation of Confidential Letter No.372 dated
July 21, 1932 from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
------------

To the Shanghai Municipal Council.

    According to a report received, Communists are at
present very active in Shanghai. They organize certain
societies etc. with a view to carrying on their activities
secretly. These activities should be suppressed. Besides
instructing those concerned to make investigations, a copy
of a list of Communist organizations is forwarded herewith
and you are requested to pay special attention to this matter
and arrange to have investigations made with a view to
suppressing them.

                                Yu Ong Kyuin,
                                Chief Secretary.
pages.zh:
大上海市政府1932年7月21日第372号密函译文。
---

致上海工部局。

    据收到的报告，共产党目前在上海非常活跃。他们组织某些社团等，旨在秘密开展活动。这些活动应予镇压。除指示有关方面进行调查外，现随函附上共产党组织名单副本，请贵局对此事予以特别注意，并安排进行调查，以便予以镇压。

                                余鸿庆 (Yu Ong Kyuin)，
                                秘书长。

pages.en:
List of Communist Organizations

Shanghai Western District Cotton Mill Workers' General Labour
Union( 沪西纱厂总工会 ), address unknown. Principal
member : Yao Ah Doo( 姚阿大 ). This is a Red Labour Union
and has branches at all Japanese owned mills.

Preparatory Committee for the Shanghai Peoples Society to
Support the North Eastern Volunteer Armies( 上海民众援助东北义勇军后
援会筹备会 ). Address unknown. This Committee has been formed
ostensibly to support the North Eastern Volunteer Armies,
but really to propagate communism. Its object is to oppose the
Kuomintang and overthrow the present government. It is the
main source of Communist activities in Shanghai.

Municipal Electrical Workers' Union( 市政电气工会 ).
Address unknown. Principal member : Tsao Ya Ch'un( 曹协群 ).
This is one of the Red Labour Unions. The workers of the
Tramway Company, Power Company and Telephone Company in the
International Settlement are all under its influence. This
body was not very active before the Sino-Japanese conflict
but started propaganda against Japan and the Chinese Government
soon after the conflict. It is reported that the recent
telephone strike was instigated by this Union.

Distressed Young Men's Anti-Japanese Mutual Aid Society.
( 被难青年反日互济会 ). Ming Tan Middle School( 鸣旦中学 ),
Avenue Foch. This body pretends to give aid to distressed youths
and help others to receive education and employment. Not active
at the present time.

Labour League( 劳动大同盟 ). Address unknown. Principal member:
Lee Chih( 李杰 ).

上海民众援助东北义勇军后援会筹备会。地址不详。该委员会名义上是为支援东北义勇军而成立，实则是为了宣传共产主义。其目标是反对国民党并推翻现政府。它是上海共产党活动的主要源头。
